Container.Name: Gods-Eye-View
Container.Overview: God's Eye View is a live open-source spatial intelligence globe: real flights, ships, satellites, earthquakes, public cameras, weather, radio and more, on a photorealistic 3D planet. This template runs it as a local web server. No API keys are required to start.
Container.Description:
God's Eye View by Bilawal Sidhu (upstream: github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view, MIT). Unofficial Unraid packaging by emenblade.
Open the WebUI at http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:4173 after the container starts.
Keys are optional and are set as container variables below (toggle "Show more settings" in the Unraid template). The in-app POWER UP panel is disabled over LAN by upstream design, so use these variables instead: - CESIUM_ION_TOKEN: free Cesium ion token, enables Google Photorealistic 3D cities and world terrain. - GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY: metered Google Maps key, direct Photorealistic 3D plus Google place search. - GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_API_KEY: optional separate server-side key for Places and Street View. - MAPILLARY_CLIENT_TOKEN: free Mapillary client token for the Street Level photos layer. - OPENAI_API_KEY: metered, enables voice control and the AI HUD summary. - AISSTREAM_API_KEY: free, enables live vessels. - FIRMS_MAP_KEY: free NASA FIRMS key, enables active fires. - TOMTOM_API_KEY: free tier, enables live traffic flow speeds. - OPENSKY_CLIENT_ID and OPENSKY_CLIENT_SECRET: optional, raises flight polling limits. Anonymous access works without them. - LL2_API_TOKEN: optional, raises the Launch Library 2 allowance.
If you reach the app by hostname (for example tower.local or a reverse-proxy name) rather than by IP, add that hostname to GEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS, comma separated. IP addresses always work.
Cache and log data are stored under /mnt/user/appdata/gods-eye-view. Restarting the container applies any changed keys.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface. Change the host port here, leave the container port at 4173.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Persistent upstream data caches (satellites, terrain, traffic, imagery tiles). Safe to delete while stopped.

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: Application logs (voice session debug logs are opt-in and content-free by default).

Config.Name: Allowed hostnames
Config.Description: Comma-separated hostnames, for example tower.local,globe.mydomain.tld. Required only when you open the app by name instead of by IP address.

Config.Name: Cesium ion token
Config.Description: Free token from cesium.com/ion. Enables Google Photorealistic 3D cities and world terrain. Eligible personal, non-commercial use.

Config.Name: Google Maps API key
Config.Description: Optional metered Google Maps key. Direct Photorealistic 3D Tiles plus Google place search. Restrict it at Google Cloud.

Config.Name: Google server API key
Config.Description: Optional separate server-side Google key for Places and Street View. Falls back to the Google Maps API key when empty.

Config.Name: Mapillary client token
Config.Description: Free Mapillary client token from mapillary.com/dashboard/developers. Enables the Street Level photos layer.

Config.Name: OpenAI API key
Config.Description: Optional metered OpenAI key. Enables voice control and the AI HUD summary.

Config.Name: AISStream API key
Config.Description: Free key from aisstream.io. Enables the live vessels layer.

Config.Name: NASA FIRMS map key
Config.Description: Free key from firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov. Enables the active fires layer.

Config.Name: TomTom API key
Config.Description: Free-tier key from my.tomtom.com. Enables live traffic flow speeds. The layer still simulates traffic without it.

Config.Name: OpenSky client ID
Config.Description: Optional OpenSky OAuth client ID. Raises flight polling limits; anonymous access works without it.

Config.Name: Launch Library 2 token
Config.Description: Optional Launch Library 2 token. Raises the space missions request allowance.

Config.Name: OpenAI rate limit per minute
Config.Description: Per-IP request limit for OpenAI cost endpoints. Blank uses the upstream default of 30. This is a guard, not a billing cap.

Config.Name: Google rate limit per minute
Config.Description: Per-IP request limit for Google Places endpoints. Blank uses the upstream default of 120. This is a guard, not a billing cap.
